entries.title: Regular Expression Denial of Service
entries.content: Malicious input could cause catastrophic backtracking in lexer regex patterns. Mitigation: re2c v3.1 DFA lexer (O(n)); adversarial inputs tested per token; 0.1s timeout threshold.

entries.title: Unicode Homoglyph Identifier Injection
entries.content: Unicode lookalike characters in identifiers could bypass keyword checks. Mitigation: ASCII-only identifiers [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*; UTF-8 NFC normalization before lexing.

entries.title: Keyword Prefix Ambiguity
entries.content: Identifiers like 'iff' or 'ifoo' could be mis-tokenized as keywords. Mitigation: Negative lookahead (?![A-Za-z0-9_]) on all keywords; 'iff' explicitly banned.

entries.title: Adversarial WASM Parser Input
entries.content: Malformed WASM or oversized inputs to parser could crash or hang runtime. Mitigation: Cycle 6 adversarial attack surface audit; fuzz command (1000 iterations); SHA-3 final hash.

entries.title: IPFS Gateway SSRF
entries.content: Malicious import paths could target internal network via IPFS gateway fetch. Mitigation: CID validation; 10s timeout; ipfs:// prefix enforcement; content hash verification.

entries.title: Post-Quantum Signature Forgery
entries.content: Forged PQ signatures on AST artifacts could bypass integrity checks. Mitigation: Dilithium3 (NIST PQC finalist) sign/verify on canonical AST bytes.

entries.title: ZK-SNARK Proof Bypass
entries.content: Invalid Groth16 proofs could allow unverified AST to pass verification. Mitigation: arkworks Groth16 BN254; AST hash commitment circuit; proof deserialization validation.

entries.title: Self-Mutating Grammar Drift
entries.content: Runtime grammar mutations could introduce ambiguous or unreachable constructs. Mitigation: Version bumping on mutation; mutation log; feature_matrix_v2.json orthogonality checks.
